NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 144

He hasn't been served yet. He will be served soon.

还沒有人来招待他。很快会有人来招待他的。

A picture lesson on the present perfect passive and the future passive. Eight pictures show 'hasn't been done yet' questions and their answers: hasn't anyone repaired this car yet / it has already been repaired; hasn't anyone corrected these exercise books yet / they have already been corrected; hasn't anyone caught the thief yet / he hasn't been caught yet, he will be caught soon; hasn't anyone caught the thieves yet / they haven't been caught yet, they will be caught soon. The lesson introduces written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 143 story), B (answer questions imitating the example, 'someone has done it / it has already been done'), and C (answer questions imitating the example, 'it hasn't been done yet, it will be done tomorrow'). The workbook drills passive dialogues ('It hasn't been done yet, but it will be done soon') and open-ended situations; the grammar workbook answers questions with 'No, not yet, but ... will be ...' and 'No, it/they has/have only just been ...'. This is the final lesson of Book 1.
